# Unattended

> Claude Code tutorials and AI agent automation guides: hooks, headless mode, scheduling, permissions and cost control.

Guides are researched from official sources, cite them, and are reviewed regularly.

## Guides
- [AI Agent Evaluation Metrics: Pass Rate Across Repeat Runs](https://en.aobaworks.com/ai-agent-evaluation-metrics-pass-rate-across-repeat-runs/): AI agent evaluation metrics for Claude Code: compute pass@k, pass^k, variance across N reruns and judge-score drift to catch flaky or silently wrong runs.
- [CLAUDE.md Best Practices: A Template for Unattended Agents](https://en.aobaworks.com/claude-md-best-practices-a-template-for-unattended-agents/): CLAUDE.md best practices for headless and scheduled Claude Code runs: a ready template, the --bare trap, and rules that stop overnight agents stalling.
- [AI Agent Evaluation Framework: Claude Code Eval Loop Steps](https://en.aobaworks.com/ai-agent-evaluation-framework-claude-code-eval-loop-steps/): An AI agent evaluation framework for Claude Code: write tasks and graders, run each several times, and track pass rate and pass^k. Includes a harness.
- [AI Agent Monitoring in Claude Code: Catch Silent Failures](https://en.aobaworks.com/ai-agent-monitoring-in-claude-code-catch-silent-failures/): AI agent monitoring for solo builders: use Claude Code hooks, a cron wrapper and a free heartbeat check to catch silent failures without a monitoring stack.
- [Claude Code Headless Mode: Flags, Auth and Cost (2026)](https://en.aobaworks.com/claude-code-headless-mode-flags-auth-and-cost-2026/): Claude Code headless mode explained: the -p flags, output formats, API key vs setup-token auth, and cost caps you need for unattended cron and CI runs.
- [Claude Code on VPS: systemd Setup That Survives Reboots](https://en.aobaworks.com/claude-code-on-vps-systemd-setup-that-survives-reboots/): Run Claude Code on a VPS unattended: install on Ubuntu or Hostinger, store a token safely, schedule jobs with systemd timers, and harden SSH and firewall.
- [Claude Code Subagents Model Selection: Role-by-Role Table](https://en.aobaworks.com/claude-code-subagents-model-selection-role-by-role-table/): Claude Code subagents model selection made practical: when to give each subagent Haiku, Sonnet, Opus or inherit, with official prices, steps and fixes.
- [Claude Code Stuck on Compacting Conversation: Cron Watchdog](https://en.aobaworks.com/claude-code-stuck-on-compacting-conversation-cron-watchdog/): Claude Code stuck on compacting conversation? Why it hangs in headless and cron runs, the real auto-compact defaults, and a watchdog script that recovers.
- [Claude Code Subagent allowed-tools: Syntax, Examples, Fixes](https://en.aobaworks.com/claude-code-subagent-allowed-tools-syntax-examples-fixes/): Claude Code subagent allowed-tools explained: the real field is tools, plus disallowedTools, MCP wildcards, inherit vs restrict, and hooks that enforce it.
- [AI Agent vs Automation: A 5-Question Test for Claude Code](https://en.aobaworks.com/ai-agent-vs-automation-a-5-question-test-for-claude-code/): AI agent vs automation, settled with a 5-question test: when a Claude Code agent is worth its cost and when a plain script or cron job is the better choice.
- [Claude Code Permissions Best Practices: Headless Template](https://en.aobaworks.com/claude-code-permissions-best-practices-headless-template/): Claude Code permissions best practices for unattended runs: a settings.json allow/deny template, mode picks, and pre-flight checks so overnight jobs finish.
- [AI Agent Guardrails Example: Copy-Paste Claude Code Rules](https://en.aobaworks.com/ai-agent-guardrails-example-copy-paste-claude-code-rules/): An AI agent guardrails example for Claude Code: copy-paste permission rules, hooks and CLI caps that stop runaway loops, destructive commands and cost spikes.
- [Claude Code Rate Limit Reached: Retry Setup for Cron Jobs](https://en.aobaworks.com/claude-code-rate-limit-reached-retry-setup-for-cron-jobs/): Claude Code rate limit reached? Tell a 429 throttle from a plan or spend cap, read the retry-after headers, and set safe auto-retries for headless cron jobs.
- [Claude Code Hooks Examples: 7 Copy-Paste Scripts](https://en.aobaworks.com/claude-code-hooks-examples-7-copy-paste-scripts/): Claude Code hooks examples you can copy: 7 working scripts for guardrails, Stop-hook stall prevention, and usage logging, with settings.json and fixes.
- [Claude Code: How to See Token Usage (and Reduce It)](https://en.aobaworks.com/claude-code-how-to-see-token-usage-and-reduce-it/): Claude Code how to see token usage: run /usage in a session, read total_cost_usd from headless JSON runs, check the Console Usage page, and set cost alerts.
- [Claude Code Hooks Lifecycle: Every Event, Explained](https://en.aobaworks.com/claude-code-hooks-lifecycle-every-event-explained/): Claude Code hooks lifecycle explained: when each hook event fires in an automation run, and which ones stop runaway token use or silent failures.
- [Claude Code Cron Job Setup: Run Automations Overnight](https://en.aobaworks.com/claude-code-cron-job-setup-run-automations-overnight/): Claude Code cron job setup: auth tokens, PATH, working directory, permissions, locks and log rotation, so overnight claude -p runs don't fail silently.
- [Claude Code Checkpoints: How Rollback Works in Automations](https://en.aobaworks.com/claude-code-checkpoints-how-rollback-works-in-automations/): How Claude Code checkpoints work in headless jobs: enable SDK file checkpointing, save UUIDs, rewind unattended runs, and learn what rewind can't undo.
- [Why Claude Code Stops Mid-Automation (and How to Fix It)](https://en.aobaworks.com/why-claude-code-stops-mid-automation-and-how-to-fix-it/): Why does Claude Code stop running headless automations? Map the turn, budget, timeout and permission triggers in claude -p runs, plus a fix checklist.
